name: Audio Wave Visualiser
description: Full-screen WebGL shader of three flowing neon wave lines that idle calmly and react to music with bass, mid, high and kick-drum ripples once a play button starts the audio.
contents: Full-screen shader canvas with three wave lines, glowing balls and optional film grain
Centered caption, large quote headline and subtitle
behavior: Idle slow waves ease into audio-reactive motion when playback starts
Web Audio analyser splits the spectrum into bass, mid and high bands and detects kick beats
Kicks trigger ripples, bounce and color flashes
Audio loops and stops on unmount

props.name: caption
props.default: Find beauty in the space between sound

props.name: subtitle
props.default: When you learn to see the invisible, you create the impossible

editableByProps: Caption, headline, subtitle and button labels
Reactivity, speed, wave shape, line thickness and grain amounts

needsCodeEdit.change: Change frequency bands used for analysis
Change wave shapes and glow look

fixed: Root is full-bleed and h-screen with a black background
Requires user click to start audio because of browser autoplay rules
Audio source must allow cross-origin access (CORS) for analysis
Window pointermove listener for the custom cursor is removed on unmount
Uses next/font/google for the headline and caption fonts
